_comment: The curated set, by reference. Nothing here is vendored into this repo.
Most of these carry no licence file, which under copyright means the author
kept every right - so redistributing a copy would be infringement even
though the code is public. The installer clones from each upstream instead,
which keeps the author's name on the work and lets their fixes reach you.
Verify a licence yourself before relying on any of these commercially.

marketplaces.name: claude-plugins-official
marketplaces.use: frontend-design - design judgement for anything visual

marketplaces.name: ponytail
marketplaces.use: laziest-that-works mindset; stops over-engineering before it starts

marketplaces.name: caveman
marketplaces.use: compressed replies; cuts filler without losing technical detail

marketplaces.name: ui-ux-pro-max
marketplaces.use: UI and UX review before markup gets written

skills.name: impeccable
skills.note: The only one to run its own installer. SKILL.md is generated from SKILL.src.md and still holds {{scripts_path}} placeholders, so a plain copy installs a broken skill.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.note: Ships in a directory called taste-skill but declares name: design-taste-frontend. Install under the declared name so the two agree.
skills.label: design-taste-frontend

skills.name: karpathy-guidelines
skills.note: Surgical edits, no overcomplication, stated assumptions, verifiable success criteria.

skills.name: emilkowalski-motion
skills.note: pick-ui-library, prototype and review-animations set disable-model-invocation, so they never appear in the skills listing and run only when invoked by name. Absent from the listing is not absent from disk.

skills.name: claude-seo
skills.note: ~30 SEO skills. MIT licensed, the only set here with an explicit licence.
skills.label: claude-seo (~30 SEO skills)

cli.name: lean-ctx
cli.note: A global CLI, not a project plugin. Its MCP server and hooks live in ~/.claude/settings.json, outside any project.
